component.name: Zwyka
component.summary: Track habits, build streaks, and schedule reminders

description.p: Zwyka is an open source code cross-platform habits tracking application without Ads and limitations. The goal of the solution is to create a habits tracking application that is intuitive, efficient, and inclusive. That empowers users to effortlessly manage their habits while ensuring that no one is left behind.

ul.li: Habits with a title, remarks, an icon, a color, and active days of the week
Habits Calendar: day progress per habit from "started" up to "over 100%"
Day Streaks and today's overall progress
Metrics: daily completion over the last 66 days
Schedule: day view with hours, reminders, and export to an external calendar
Localizations: EN, AR, AZ, BE, CS, DE, ES, FA, FR, HI, ID, IT, JA, KA, KO, NL, PL, PT, RO, RU, TR, UK, UZ, ZH

description.p: All data is stored locally on the device: no accounts, no analytics, no tracking.

This is an "open source code" application that welcomes and values contributions from the community. However, there are some restrictions when it comes to external modification and distribution, as it follows the CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0 license.
